issues.on_page: Miscellaneous 805,946 = General 271,639 (p15: Lease income - BASWA 68,880, donations 202,388, Sidewalk program 371) + Economic Development Miscellaneous 311,390 (p21) + Capital Improvements Donations and other revenue 222,918 (p27)
issues.issue: The schedules print a breakdown of this line: donations 202,388 + 'Donations and other revenue' 222,918 = 425,306 (52.8%), which is more than half. The rule says to use that category or split it. Kept as other; a judgment call because the 222,918 line is itself mixed

The governmental funds statement counts this in 'Interest' (Other Governmental Funds interest 2,425 = 991 + 129 + 915 + 390, p6), not in Special assessments 4,733. Interest Income or Penalties and Interest on Taxes may fit better
CDBG money is a federal (HUD) program passed through the state; federal grants may fit. Grantor not printed (review already set); same for detail[136]

Capital outlay lines with no 'Capital Outlay: <function>' label (also detail[155] Public building improvements 65,564 and detail[162] Computer equipment 88,737, p27). No function is printed, so this is defensible, but it is not the standard label
